description:
Stable High-Carbon Steel Frame

Built with a robust high-carbon steel frame, this mountain bike delivers exceptional strength and durability. Tackle demanding mountain trails with confidence, enjoying a comfortable and secure ride over rough terrain.

18-Speed Precision Drivetrain

Take full control with 18 speeds. Experience smooth, precise gear shifts to conquer steep inclines and enjoy effortless riding, perfect for both beginners and seasoned cyclists.

Perfect Fit for Women & Men

Designed for adults 5' to 5'8", the convenient step-through frame makes mounting and dismounting easy. The adjustable soft foam saddle ensures lasting comfort on every ride.

Sporty & Safe Performance

Ride with assurance. Powerful dual V-brakes deliver reliable stopping power, while all-terrain XC sport tires provide non-slip, puncture-resistant traction on rugged paths.

Quick & Easy Assembly

Get riding fast! The bike arrives 90% pre-assembled. Complete setup is simple using the included tools and our step-by-step video guide on the product page.

Shop the Hiland Lilac 2 Women's Mountain Bike. Features a lightweight aluminum frame, 18-speed drivetrain, and dual V brakes for ultimate trail comfort and safety.
